mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recurring_expenses (user_id, expense_desc, amount, category, transaction_type, day_of_month) VALUES (#{userId}, #{request.expenseDesc}, #{request.amount}, #{request.category}, #{request.transactionType}, #{request.dayOfMonth})
mapper.select: SELECT recurring_id AS recurringId, expense_desc AS expenseDesc, amount, category, transaction_type AS transactionType, day_of_month AS dayOfMonth, is_active AS isActive FROM recurring_expenses WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = true ORDER BY day_of_month
mapper.update: UPDATE recurring_expenses SET is_active = false WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND recurring_id = #{recurringId}
